[[File:CrimsonTalon_BloodRazorOutpost.jpg|170px|thumb|The Blood Razor outpost in Crimson Talon]]
'''Crimson Talon''' was an area of space in the [[Karthakk system]]. The [[Blood Razors]] inhabited the Crimson Talon territory, only venturing out from [[Blood Razors outpost|their outpost]] to sabotage the expansion efforts by the [[Kimogila Fanatics|Kimogilia Fanatics]]. The war between these two [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] factions presented much danger to those wishing to travel through the area. Pitched on either side of the [[Spine of Lok]], the Kimogila Fanatics and the Blood Razors often met in the middle to engage in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]].
